data.current_summary: Start a 60-day trial with just an email
data.current_description:
Get a working key from an email alone - built for tools like n8n, where the user types an email into a credential and never copies a key.

Every endpoint is included for 60 days, then the key moves to the free plan. The key answers 403 `TRIAL_UNVERIFIED` until the emailed link is clicked. Asking again for the same email issues a new key (the old one stops working) and a new link, but never restarts the trial.
data.summary_suggestion: Generate a trial API key from email address
data.description_suggestion: Generate a 60-day trial API key using only an email address. Requires the email in the request body. Returns a new API key and sends a verification link to the provided email. The key is inactive (returns 403 TRIAL_UNVERIFIED) until the verification link is clicked. After 60 days, the key automatically downgrades to the free plan. Requesting a trial for an existing email generates a new key (invalidating the previous one) and sends a new verification link, but does not extend the trial period. Designed for credential managers like n8n where users provide email without manually copying keys.

data.current_summary: Get canonical plan quotas, pricing, and features
data.current_description:
Single source of truth for plan quotas, pricing, and feature lists.

Public, unauthenticated endpoint - the website, customer dashboard, and
transactional email copy should fetch this instead of hardcoding plan
numbers, so they can't silently drift from what the API actually
enforces. See `docs/config-centralization-audit-2026-06-22.md`.

Also includes `watched_companies_limit` - the number of distinct companies
a plan may watch via webhooks (null = unlimited). A key's individual limit
may be higher than its plan default if the Compliance Monitoring add-on is
active (see `POST /v1/webhooks`).

Example: `GET /v1/plans`
data.description_suggestion: Retrieve the canonical plan definitions including quotas, pricing, feature availability, and webhook watch limits. This public, unauthenticated endpoint returns all active plans with their call limits, pricing tiers, and feature flags. Use this to determine plan-specific capabilities (e.g., network depth=2, compliance endpoints) and webhook watch caps. Individual keys may have higher limits if the Compliance Monitoring add-on is active.
